findings.highlight: from the yard to the front door.
findings.governingReading: 中庭から門へ向かう locates them already outdoors in the property, moving toward its gate before looking up at the annex.
findings.explanation: Moving from the courtyard to the estate gate becomes moving to the front door.

findings.highlight: She cares more about regretting her actions
findings.evidenceJa: 悔いる事を強要している
findings.governingReading: 悔いる事を強要している describes compelling remorse in herself rather than favoring it, within Saber’s account of extreme self-blame.
findings.explanation: Self-imposed remorse is softened into caring more about regret.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分ひとりでも胸を張れる
findings.governingReading: 自分ひとりでも contrasts independent self-respect with relief only when she is with Shirou.
findings.explanation: Pride possible even on her own becomes simply more pride in herself.

findings.highlight: make a girl her age constantly do house chores.
findings.evidenceJa: 女の子が家事手伝いばかりに奔走
findings.governingReading: 年頃の女の子が家事手伝いばかりに奔走 is the girl’s ongoing self-driven activity that Shirou considers unhealthy.
findings.explanation: A girl busying herself solely with chores becomes making her do chores.
